subtasks: Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.
Use the right gripper to pick up the pink nut, seat it upright on the pink bolt, screw it down, and release it. Retract the left arm clear of the installed yellow pair.

Install the loose white nut on the fixed white bolt at the right. Grasp the white nut, carry it upright to the white bolt, seat and tighten it, then release it. Keep the yellow and pink pairs in place.

The yellow, pink, and white nuts have been turned and released on their matching bolts. Keep both grippers fully open. Withdraw the right gripper upward clear of the white pair, then return both arms to their initial resting poses.
